gaps.explanation: No missing line. The statement transfers_in 56,173 is the p5 Total Governmental Funds figure ('Transfers from other funds' General 7,513 + Street 43,660 + Other Governmental Funds 5,000). detail[] records the General Fund transfers gross by department from p13: in 24,750, out (17,237) (net 7,513 = General column); plus Street 43,660 (p10) and Other Governmental Funds 5,000 (p12). Ins 24,750 + 43,660 + 5,000 = 73,410; out (17,237); 73,410 - 17,237 = 56,173 = statement. Gross vs net only; labels have the right sign.

p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns; neither is in detail[]. JSON business-type receipts = total operating revenues 182,996 + Interest income 356 = 183,352. Added: Sales 88,554 + 81,175; Other revenue 4,012 + 9,255; Interest income 140 + 216. Sum 183,352 = statement total.
